title: Ethiopian Beef Curry
community: Urban Ethiopia — the everyday curry adapted for Ethiopian spice
author: Chef Haile
desc: Ethiopian Beef Curry — beef stewing cuts simmered with an Ethiopian curry sauce of berbere, turmeric, cardamom, and tomato. The beef version of the Ethiopian curry — same spice tradition as ETH039 applied to more affordable stewing beef.
longDesc: Ethiopian beef curry is the accessible cousin of the lamb curry — stewing beef rather than lamb, slightly more affordable, equally deeply spiced. The berbere gives it a distinctly Ethiopian character.
steps: See ETH039 — substitute beef for lamb. Beef takes slightly longer — 75—80 minutes.
chefTips: Stewing beef needs longer than lamb — patient simmering is essential.
cookingScience: See ETH026 for beef stew cooking science.
sustainabilityTips: Stewing cuts make the most of the whole animal.
culturalNote: Ethiopian beef curry is the weekday interpretation of the Ethiopian spice tradition — the curry format making Ethiopian spices accessible to those more familiar with that cooking style.
